# External issues

  * **[[Youtube] HTTP Error 403 when using bgutil-ytdlp-pot-provider plugin #17368](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17368)**
  * [ffmpeg can't seek in Youtube's iOS m3u8 streams / `--download-sections` only downloads audio #9552](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9552)
    * Use `-S proto:https` or `--extractor-args "youtube:player_client=default,-ios"`
  * [`--cookies-from-browser` "Permission denied" errors when Chrome/chromium-based browser is open in Windows #7271](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7271)
    * Try after closing chrome completely OR
    * Launch chrome from command line w/ `chrome.exe --disable-features=LockProfileCookieDatabase`
    * Alternatively, you can [install](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installing-plugins) the [ChomeCookieUnlock yt-dlp plugin](https://github.com/seproDev/yt-dlp-ChromeCookieUnlock)
  * [`--cookies-from-browser`: WARNING: failed to decrypt with DPAPI / ERROR: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'decode' #10927](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10927)
  * [[youtube] Is downloading a livestream in 1440p or 2160p no longer available? #11262](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11262)
  * [[Youtube] 8k VR180 SBS videos no longer available #9903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9903)
    * Use `--extractor-arg "youtube:player_client=android_vr,default"`
  * [[Youtube] throttling and inconsistent speed in Russia #10443](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443)
    * [Workarounds](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443#issuecomment-2248940967)
  * [[Discord bot] Music stops in the middle #8854](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8854)
  * [[youtube] Endless "Incomplete data received" when downloading playlist #10394](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10394)
    * Don't use `--extractor-retries infinite`
  * [FFMPEG "Invalid data found when processing input" on live/post-live/dash videos (duplicate ftyp) #8641](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8641)
    * Regression in ffmpeg 6.1. Upgrade to ffmpeg 6.1.1 or to [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases) revision `N-112916` or later
  * [[youtube] "Invalid data found when processing input" / ffmpeg errors on HDR VP9 in mp4 #7541](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7541)
    * ffmpeg bug. Upgrade to ffmpeg 7.0.1 or to the latest [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases)
  * [`--mark-watched` fails with urlopen error #8149](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8149)
    * Disable pi-hole or whitelist `s.youtube.com`
  * [Chapter Embedding Results in Unnamed Chapters When Using Recent FFmpeg Builds #6859](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6859)
    * ffmpeg regression. Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds> or upgrade to 6.1.1 or newer
  * [yt-dlp is detected as a virus #25](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/25)
    * It's a false positive. Complain to your vendor. There is nothing we can do
  * [Incomplete Data Recieved #1787](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1787)
    * Broken from Youtube's side. If downloading comments, use `-i` to ignore the error
  * [Wrong year in metadata in M4A, MP4, FLAC format #3087](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3087)
    * Workaround: `--parse-metadata "%(release_year,upload_date).4s:(?P<meta_date>.+)"`
  * [pyinstaller temp files are not cleaned up when using yt-dlp.exe with mpv #10294](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10294)
  * [Long Start-Up Time for `yt-dlp_macos` #10425](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10425)
  * [`--download-sections` / ffmpeg fails to seek in a 26+ hour long Twitch m3u8 #5372](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5372)
  * [Using proxy and `--download-sections`/ ffmpeg fails with HTTP Error 400/401/403 #12915](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12915)



# FAQ

See <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ>

  * **[How to avoid Youtube's new "Super Resolution" AI-upscaled formats #15325](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15325)**
  * **[Getting deno to work in Termux. #15095 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15095#issuecomment-3544324838)**
    * Run a full Termux upgrade with `pkg update && pkg upgrade` before `pkg install deno`
  * **[[YouTube] Enhanced bitrate no longer available to download? #14133 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14133#issuecomment-3217679575)**
  * [**Filename too long**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1136#issuecomment-932077195)
    * Use `-o "%(title).150B [%(id)s].%(ext)s"`
  * **[[YouTube]`--write-comments`: "Incomplete data received. Giving up after 3 retries" warnings #15435](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15435)**
  * **[twitter: No video could be found in this tweet #14742](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14742)**
  * [[Question] odd ba* format selection? #979 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/979#issuecomment-919629354)
    * Generally do not use `ba*`
  * [Fix playlist_index's inconsistent behavior #302](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/302)
    * Check `playlist_autonumber` and `--compat-option playlist-index`
  * [yt-dlp python module not compiling with pyinstaller #3845](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3845)
    * Use `bundle/pyinstaller.py`
  * [Subtitle file is not deleted after being embedded #630 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/630#issuecomment-893659460)
    * Use `--compat-option no-keep-subs`
  * [`--download-sections`/`--sponsorblock-remove` does not cut at exact point #4216](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4216) / [YouTube Clip Downloads have unintented extra beginning part with no video #5080](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5080)
    * Use `--force-keyframes-at-cuts`
  * [Duplicating pull request from youtube-dl to yt-dlp #4202](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4202)
  * [How to check in browser if the video is DRM protected](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4062#issuecomment-1153474056)
  * [\--cookies-from-browser for a chrome/firefox like browser or non-default install location #2903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2903)
  * [What are yt-dlp's error codes? #4262 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4262#issuecomment-1173133105)
  * [Extractor option `language` for `crunchyrollbeta` #4640](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4640)

  * Download only videos with subtitles 
    * `--parse-metadata "%(subtitles.\:.0.ext|)s:^(?!\[\])(?P<has_subs>.)" -v --match-filter has_subs`
  * [How do I rename previously-downloaded files with nothing but the youtube video ID? #5692](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5692)
  * Remove specific fields from info-json - [[Suggestion] Redact `formats` in info json with an option #455 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/455#issuecomment-1367741786)
  * About subtitles in mp4 container - [Convert webvtt subtitles in mp4 into useable format #5833 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5833#issuecomment-1358246240)
  * [Find the API option for a CLI argument #5859 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5859#issuecomment-1363938900)
    * Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/devscripts/cli_to_api.py>
  * [[YouTube] `youtube:skip=translated_subs` doesn't work for some videos. #3875](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3875)

  * [repo: git log broken by SSH signature #7322](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7322)
  * [download comments into separate comments.json file #2372 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2372#issuecomment-1506413976)
  * [How to force a conversion to a specific video codec? #7607 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7607#issuecomment-1636960750)

## Description

[](https://github.com/DOSforever)

[DOSforever](https://github.com/DOSforever)

opened [on Sep 27, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17745#issue-5600536348)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm asking a question and **not** reporting a bug or requesting a feature
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar questions **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

Previously, the generated file name matched the language of the title: if the title was in Chinese, the file name was in Chinese; if it was in English, the file name was in English; if it was mixed Chinese and English, the file name was mixed too. But starting from the most recent versions, even if the title is in English, the generated file name turns out in Chinese.

For example, <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EDmR8adJRyA> , the web page title shows:  
`13 Minutes to Understand the WiFi Scam #WiFiSignal #WallPenetrationKing #RouterRecommendations #5... - YouTube`  
However, the downloaded file name is:  
`13 分鐘帶你了解 WIFI 騙局#WiFi穿牆 #穿牆王 #路由器推薦 #5GWiFi #科技實驗室 #物理科普 [EDmR8adJRyA]`

* * *

为什么下载后生成的文件名所用语言与网页标题所用的语言不一致？

以前标题是什么语言，生成的文件名就是什么语言，中文就是中文，英文就是英文，中英混合就中英混合，可从最近几个版本起，标题是英文的，生成的文件名却变成中文的了。  
比如 <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EDmR8adJRyA> ，网页所显示的标题为  
`13 Minutes to Understand the WiFi Scam #WiFiSignal #WallPenetrationKing #RouterRecommendations #5... - YouTube`  
然而下载文件所生成的文件名标题却是  
`13 分鐘帶你了解 WIFI 騙局#WiFi穿牆 #穿牆王 #路由器推薦 #5GWiFi #科技實驗室 #物理科普 [EDmR8adJRyA]`

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Austria

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

They changed something. Taking the test url `https://www.servustv.com/natur/v/aa-28bycqnh92111/` from [here](https://github.com/seproDev/yt-dlp/blob/18c1a502d0c65b5b57b91bf01c2fa2bb2ab549d8/yt_dlp/extractor/servus.py#L26), it now redirects to `https://www.servustv.com/de/page/AA-28BYCQNH92111` and yt-dlp doesnt know what to do with it.  
Worked still on the 1. May, broken today 5. May.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I noticed today the list of playlists from a specific channel only returns 60 out of 92 playlists. When i view by web browser, i can see 4 requests being made to get the list of playlists but yt-dlp only gets 2.

The playlist titled "Black Ops 3" is the last playlist obtained by yt-dlp but there are additional loaded in when scrolling down farther within a browser.

Something to note, the very next playlist (now on page 3) after "Black Ops 3" titled "The Paranormal Action Squad" is missing the "View full playlist" under its title, mousing over the playlist doesn't show the "Play All" hover or text, and clicking on it takes you to the playlist list view instead of playing the videos. I'm unsure if that might be messing with something within yt-dlp.

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

I'm using deno as the JS runtime.

I can't confirm this, but I _believe_ IMDB was working properly a week ago on the current 2026.03.17 release, so this is probably due to an IMDB site change.

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

India

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I am trying to download videos from JioHotstar. The videos are downloading but it is failing to grab the video title. Earlier that was not the case.

For example for this video:  
<https://www.hotstar.com/in/shows/khichdi/1648/heera-is-upset-about-her-marriage/1000036487/watch>

It is downloading the video but it is giving two warnings:  
WARNING: [hotstar] 1000036487: Unable to download JSON metadata: HTTP Error 410: Gone  
WARNING: Extractor failed to obtain "title". Creating a generic title instead

The output title should be "Heera is upset about her marriage" but it is "hotstar video #1000036487 [1000036487]"

First I tried it with the latest stable build. Didn't work. Then I installed the latest nightly build but it didn't work with that as well.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output
    
    
    [debug] Command-line config: ['-vU', 'https://www.hotstar.com/in/shows/khichdi/1648/heera-is-upset-about-her-marriage/1000036487/watch', '--cookies-from-browser', 'chrome']

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When I try to download a video, using an iframe URL, such as [https://vk.com/video_ext.php?oid=-24139285&id=456276595](https://vk.com/video_ext.php?oid=-24139285&id=456276595) — I get an error "Unable to extract player params". For the corresponding web page, in this case <https://vkvideo.ru/video-24139285_456276595> — downloading works fine.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Description

yt-dlp fails to extract the video from an X/Twitter post with the following error:

ERROR: [twitter] 2103382268051964103: Failed to parse JSON (caused by JSONDecodeError("Expecting value in '': line 1 column 1 (char 0)"))

The error occurs while yt-dlp is attempting to retrieve the GraphQL JSON response from X.

The affected URL is:

<https://x.com/jcarlos2001/status/2103382268051964103>  
Command  
yt-dlp -f mp4 '<https://x.com/jcarlos2001/status/2103382268051964103>'  
Output  
WARNING: "-f mp4" selects the best pre-merged mp4 format which is often not what's intended.  
Pre-merged mp4 formats are not available from all sites, or may only be available in lower quality.  
To prioritize the best h264 video and aac audio in an mp4 container, use "-t mp4" instead.  
If you know what you are doing and want a pre-merged mp4 format, use "-f b[ext=mp4]" instead to suppress this warning  
[twitter] Extracting URL: <https://x.com/jcarlos2001/status/2103382268051964103>  
[twitter] 2103382268051964103: Downloading guest token  
[twitter] 2103382268051964103: Downloading GraphQL JSON  
ERROR: [twitter] 2103382268051964103: Failed to parse JSON (caused by JSONDecodeError("Expecting value in '': line 1 column 1 (char 0)")); please report this issue on <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=> , filling out the appropriate issue template. Confirm you are on the latest version using `yt-dlp -U`  
Expected behavior

yt-dlp should successfully extract the available video formats from the X/Twitter post and download the video.

Actual behavior

The Twitter extractor successfully identifies the URL and obtains a guest token, but fails when parsing the JSON returned by the GraphQL request.

Additional information

The warning concerning -f mp4 appears before the extraction error. It does not appear to be the cause of the failure; the extraction fails during the Twitter/X API response parsing stage.

The failure occurs specifically at:

Downloading GraphQL JSON

followed by:

Failed to parse JSON  
JSONDecodeError("Expecting value in '': line 1 column 1 (char 0)")

A similar Failed to parse JSON problem has previously been reported for the Twitter extractor, suggesting that changes on X's side may affect the API/GraphQL response expected by yt-dlp.

System information

Please replace the following with the output of:

yt-dlp -vU -f mp4 '<https://x.com/jcarlos2001/status/2103382268051964103>'  
WARNING: "-f mp4" selects the best pre-merged mp4 format which is often not what's intended.  
Pre-merged mp4 formats are not available from all sites, or may only be available in lower quality.  
To prioritize the best h264 video and aac audio in an mp4 container, use "-t mp4" instead.  
If you know what you are doing and want a pre-merged mp4 format, use "-f b[ext=mp4]" instead to suppress this warning  
[twitter] Extracting URL: <https://x.com/jcarlos2001/status/2103382268051964103>  
[twitter] 2103382268051964103: Downloading guest token  
[twitter] 2103382268051964103: Downloading GraphQL JSON  
ERROR: [twitter] 2103382268051964103: Failed to parse JSON (caused by JSONDecodeError("Expecting value in '': line 1 column 1 (char 0)")); please report this issue on <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=> , filling out the appropriate issue template. Confirm you are on the latest version using yt-dlp -U

Also:

yt-dlp --version  
Latest version: stable@2026.08.19 from yt-dlp/yt-dlp  
yt-dlp is up to date (stable@2026.08.19 from yt-dlp/yt-dlp)

URL

<https://x.com/jcarlos2001/status/2103382268051964103>

  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

I am in Denmark, if that's the question?

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

For maybe two weeks - ten days? - I haven't been able to download more than maybe five videos with yt-dlp. I usually download at least ten videos each day (in very low resolution), for my own archiving needs and hoarding instincts. I haven't made a systematic analysis to see if I can see a pattern in which videos I can download and which get rejected, but I don't think there is one. It's both brand new videos as well as some that are some weeks old.

What happens is that it downloads the two English subtitle files as normal, the .json file (if I ask for that), and then.... nothing. It just freezes. Even under debug mode, it doesn't say anything for many seconds.

I finally asked the AI, and it suggested it was to do with cookies, so I added the --cookies-from-browser firefox command, and it worked on the URL I tried it on, so I thought it was solved, but none of the subsequent URLs I tried it on worked. I read in some of the text on this site that it could help to export the cookies as a .txt file.

And the first URL I try it on, it works! I tried it on <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFSqT9xJCmk> for the 360p resolution. I thought maybe it was a fluke, so I tried to get it in the 240p resolution, and it gave me that as well!

So again I thought, "finally!". But it works with none of the other URLs I have.

I also read on this site that it might help to open an incognito window, then login to your Youtube account, and then export the cookies for youtube using the addon called "cookies.txt".

When I tried the --cookies command with this file, it downloaded the subtitles again, and then it began on the video stream as well! But after the first update (it reached "3.5%") it froze just like normal! As if it was fooled into giving me some, but then another process kicked in and determined I shouldn't be allowed anyway.

I can see videos totally fine on the site itself (even though I did feel there was some sluggishness in my internet over the past couple of days, but that seems to have resolved now).

Does anyone have these problems other than me?! I was expecting to see this issues forum overflowing with messages about Youtube no longer working, and I am shocked it isn't the case. Is it after all still something that's wrong on my side?

Can anybody help me?

DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

After providing the name of a Firefox profile to --cookies-from-browser, yt-dlp says "could not find firefox cookies database".

Steps to reproduce the problem:  
Run the following command:  
yt-dlp.exe --cookies-from-browser firefox:"Redacted Phrase" <https://www.example.net>

Expected Result:  
yt-dlp should locate the cookies from the profile named "Redacted Phrase" without showing an error message.

Actual Result:  
ERROR: could not find firefox cookies database in 'C:\Users\Zian\AppData\Roaming\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\Redacted Phrase', 'C:\Users\Zian\AppData\Local\Packages\Mozilla.Firefox_n80bbvh6b1yt2\LocalCache\Roaming\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\Redacted Phrase'

Workaround:

  1. Open a new browser tab.
  2. Go to about:profiles.
  3. Locate the "Root Path" of the desired profile.  
Example value:  
C:\Users\Zian\AppData\Roaming\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\vru7w2wr.Redacted Phrase
  4. Use the value from step 3 in --cokies-from-browser instead of the name of the profile.



### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Region

United States of America

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Run `yt-dlp --print id --flat-playlist https://www.youtube.com/@TeamCoco/playlists | grep -c '^'`, see that it prints 56 though <https://www.youtube.com/@TeamCoco/playlists> actually has 57 playlists (on my machine: each row 6 items + 3 more in a non-full row and there are 9 full rows, so 6*9+3=57).  
<https://www.youtube.com/show/VLPLVL8S3lUHf0T3IR5qgs_IJ17ivx9T4M3k>, which is the playlist ID `PLVL8S3lUHf0T3IR5qgs_IJ17ivx9T4M3k`, is missing.  
I think this is due to what yt-dlp already says: `WARNING: [youtube:tab] Unsupported lockup view model content type "LOCKUP_CONTENT_TYPE_SHOW"; please report this issue on https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q= , filling out the appropriate issue template. Confirm you are on the latest version using yt-dlp -U`

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

[](https://github.com/climbTheStairs)

[climbTheStairs](https://github.com/climbTheStairs)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm requesting a site-specific feature
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Example URLs

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=brhfDfLdDZ8>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

[#14567](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14567)/[#14677](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/14677) added support for yt-dlp to download the channel names in the `creator` field for all the collaborators, but yt-dlp still only saves `channel_id` and `uploader_id` (which contains the tag of the channel starting with `@`) for just the 1 uploader.

As channel names can change (unlike `channel_id`) and are not uniquely identifying (unlike `uploader_id`), it would be far more useful to also save this information for all the collaborators.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

can't download few old one videos. using by any available method.  
in reason because clients (web_embedded, tv_downgraded, visionos, android, vr and other ones) get SABR and only 18 video format available or not available at all.

it can be solved using by bgutil + mweb client without cookies.  
and youtube will provide all formats. but if downloadable videos is age-restricted that a dead.end.

logs:

  1. ordinary download using by web_embedded (with cookies) SABR (format only 18).
  2. ordinary download using by yt-dlp chosing client byself. (error is The page needs to be reloaded)
  3. download using by bgutil+mweb with cookies. (download start but in a few seconds - 403 error)
  4. download using by bgutil+mweb without cookies (download can't start because age restricted video request cookies). in case with ordinary video, download will complete OK with all formats available.



BTW. i do not think the problem is GEOBLOCK or IP because if ill try ti download other one modern videos from other channel download complete OK with any requestable format.  
otherwise, ive got same download problem with other account (cookies) and even if i use VPN or TOR proxy.

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

North America (Accessing Japan stream unsure if its geoblocked anywhere)

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Upon trying to download a purchased stream from ZAIKO I am receiving the following error:

ERROR: [Zaiko] 379223: Failed to download JWT-protected stream URL: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden (caused by <HTTPError 403: Forbidden>)

Additional Notes:

I have tried using --cookies-from-browser on Firefox and using -u and -p to provide login credentials and also providing an external cookies file. All are resulting in the identical error.

Any advice to get this resolved would be heavily appreciated!

### Region

Europe

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Multilingual videos on arte.tv produce inconsistent format sorting for audio formats when using different UI languages URLs to do the download. The most preferred video seems to always be the "correct" one, but beyond that the order does not make much sense.

Note that the format note showing the same language for every format has a separate issues already :[#11501](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11501).
    
    
    yt-dlp https://www.arte.tv/de/videos/126957-001-A/happy-valley-in-einer-kleinen-stadt-staffel-1-1-6/ -Fq

Instead we likely should just take the order as it is present in the manifest as preference. This is the same order that is presented to the user in the UI. If the website is relying on it, so can we.
    
    
    LANGUAGE="de",NAME="Deutsch"
    LANGUAGE="en",NAME="Englisch (Original)"
    LANGUAGE="fr",NAME="Französisch"
    LANGUAGE="es",NAME="Spanisch"
    LANGUAGE="de",NAME="Deutsch (Klare Sprache)"
    LANGUAGE="de",NAME="Deutsch (Audiodeskription)"
    LANGUAGE="fr",NAME="Französisch (Klare Sprache)"
    LANGUAGE="fr",NAME="Französisch (Audiodeskription)"
    

[](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/26507958/650719189-88f09f89-84fe-465a-b6fb-0134e02936c2.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.._NE_BMzEIRKPG3SddCoUZIeKgX_DUgn574kh7cTjQ6w)

Manifest format order for other UI languages:
    
    
    LANGUAGE="fr",NAME="français"
    LANGUAGE="en",NAME="anglais (VO)"
    LANGUAGE="de",NAME="allemand"
    LANGUAGE="es",NAME="espagnol"
    LANGUAGE="fr",NAME="français (confort audio)"
    LANGUAGE="fr",NAME="français (audiodescription)"
    LANGUAGE="de",NAME="allemand (confort audio)"
    LANGUAGE="de",NAME="allemand (audiodescription)"
    
    
    
    LANGUAGE="es",NAME="español"
    LANGUAGE="en",NAME="inglés (originale)"
    LANGUAGE="fr",NAME="francés"
    LANGUAGE="de",NAME="alemán"
    LANGUAGE="fr",NAME="francés (voces más claras)"
    LANGUAGE="fr",NAME="francés (audiodescripción)"
    LANGUAGE="de",NAME="alemán (voces más claras)"
    LANGUAGE="de",NAME="alemán (audiodescripción)"
    

Some information also in [#17614 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17614#issuecomment-5562637032)

Youtube live streams which aren't over yet will not be available in good quality in yt-dlp and only show low bitrate H264 streams. Since the stream has to be live at the moment of download, this issue will not be reproducible with the URL in the issue.  
I tested it with 2 streams, one defaulted to av01 and another one to vp9 when watching in Firefox while logged in or in private tab while logged out.  
[](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/68742864/650997506-92ec2e9b-b17d-470c-931f-6754c16dabd6.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Dymy5x_59_-wgJvyirbxbvcvAvPUmooy51tBCUf0gdQ)

  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Just look at the log.

The two clients in question work fine without cookies[*](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17666#issuecomment-5628365242) so this is probably an experiment that is rolling out, and I got unlucky.

I believe this means that logged-in youtube downloading is now borked if you have this experiment, unless `tv_downgraded` works for you

_No response_

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Telewebion migrated from `telewebion.ir` to `telewebion.net` after their certificate was revoked and existing extractor only accepts `telewebion.ir` links, as a result downloads from this site fail as unsupported URL.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Korea

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

If the SOOP subscription-only VOD is a multi-part VOD, an HTTP 403 error occurs when the HLS download starts for the first part, but the last part downloads normally.

Playback proceeds normally in a browser using the account used in the command line.

Possible Cause

  1. Part 1 authentication
  2. Part 1 m3u8 extraction
  3. Part 2 authentication
  4. Part 2 m3u8 extraction
  5. Using Part 2 authentication credentials when downloading Part 1 m3u8
  6. HTTP 403 error
  7. Using Part 2 authentication credentials when downloading Part 2 m3u8
  8. Download successful



### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm asking a question and **not** reporting a bug or requesting a feature
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar questions **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

Hello,  
the generic extractor [uses the html page title for the video name](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/yt_dlp/extractor/generic.py#L732C9-L732C15). Now I have a website that uses the generic extractor where this title is wrong (truncated). Why not use the title that is given in the flashvars instead and just in case this value does not exist, use the html page title?

Example KVS video (this is an example for KVS in the extractor source, my website is different): <https://youix.com/video/leningrad-zoj/>

Maybe replace it like this:
    
    
    title = flashvars.get('video_title')
    if not title:
        title = self._html_search_regex(r'<(?:h1|title)>(?:Video: )?(.+?)</(?:h1|title)>', webpage, 'title')
    

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

There are some examples of the string `(?i)` being used in `--match-filters` on the README. It seems this string enables regex matching from what I can gather.  
This however, isn't documented from what I can see.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Excluding videos that cannot be downloaded does not work for the Posts tab. Please:

  * Create a new option for this, or

  * Extend the --compat-options no-youtube-unavailable-videos option




These videos are usually private or country-restricted

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

# What the problem is

Unable to download video from niconico due to Login failure for any videos. The failure might caused due to the yt-dlp internal URL is not matching what currently niconico provide. This porblem occur when I tried to login with username and password.  
Video download is not failed when i try to download videos without login.

# How it could be fixed

By changing the URL that used to login to niconico may fix this problem. I found the code on master branch may affect this problem.

## The part of code that seems to be the problem

  * `yt-dlp/yt_dlp/extractor/niconico.py`


    
    
    class NiconicoBaseIE(InfoExtractor):
        _API_BASE = 'https://nvapi.nicovideo.jp'
        _BASE_URL = 'https://www.nicovideo.jp'
        _GEO_BYPASS = False
        _GEO_COUNTRIES = ['JP']
        _HEADERS = {
            'X-Frontend-ID': '6',
            'X-Frontend-Version': '0',
        }
        _LOGIN_BASE = 'https://account.nicovideo.jp'
        _NETRC_MACHINE = 'niconico'
    
        @property
        def is_logged_in(self):
            return bool(self._get_cookies('https://www.nicovideo.jp').get('user_session'))
    
        def _raise_login_error(self, message, expected=True):
            raise ExtractorError(f'Unable to login: {message}', expected=expected)
    
        def _perform_login(self, username, password):
            if self.is_logged_in:
                return
    
            self._request_webpage(
                f'{self._LOGIN_BASE}/login', None, 'Requesting session cookies')
            webpage = self._download_webpage(
                f'{self._LOGIN_BASE}/login/redirector', None,
                'Logging in', 'Unable to log in', headers={
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                    'Referer': f'{self._LOGIN_BASE}/login',
                }, data=urlencode_postdata({
                    'mail_tel': username,
                    'password': password,
                }))
    
            if self.is_logged_in:
                return
            elif err_msg := traverse_obj(webpage, (
                {find_element(cls='notice error')}, {find_element(cls='notice__text')}, {clean_html},
            )):
                self._raise_login_error(err_msg or 'Invalid username or password')
            elif 'oneTimePw' in webpage:
                post_url = self._search_regex(
                    r'<form[^>]+action=(["\'])(?P<url>.+?)\1', webpage, 'post url', group='url')
                mfa, urlh = self._download_webpage_handle(
                    urljoin(self._LOGIN_BASE, post_url), None,
                    'Performing MFA', 'Unable to complete MFA', headers={
                        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                    }, data=urlencode_postdata({
                        'otp': self._get_tfa_info('6 digit number shown on app'),
                    }))
                if self.is_logged_in:
                    return
                elif 'error-code' in parse_qs(urlh.url):
                    err_msg = traverse_obj(mfa, ({find_element(cls='pageMainMsg')}, {clean_html}))
                    self._raise_login_error(err_msg or 'MFA session expired')
                elif 'formError' in mfa:
                    err_msg = traverse_obj(mfa, (
                        {find_element(cls='formError')}, {find_element(tag='div')}, {clean_html}))
                    self._raise_login_error(err_msg or 'MFA challenge failed')
    
            self._raise_login_error('Unexpected login error', expected=False)

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

If using `--lazy-playlist` and using `-O playlist:%(playlist_count)s` and using a `ytsearch` pseudo-URL, `NA` is returned, even though the playlist count should be available by the time of that `WHEN`.  
~~This may be a core issue and not one specific to youtube but I'm not sure of that.~~ This does NOT happen with a regular playlist (`youtube:tab`) (`playlist_count` is returned even if `--lazy-playlist` is specified), so this is an extractor-specific issue.

Edit: While it doesn't happen with a regular playlist (`youtube.com/playlist?list=`), it does also happen with channels:

\--lazy-playlist + @channel/videos

    def _real_extract(self, url):
        album_id = self._match_id(url)

        songs = response['songs']

            'title': "name",
            'description': "description",
            'thumbnail': "picUrl",
            'upload_date': ("publishTime", {lambda x:strftime_or_none(x // 1000)}),
        }))
        
        return self.playlist_result(self._get_entries(songs), album_id, **metainfo)

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

couldn't download from a premium site (fc2video) which I have got a valid subscription on.  
I only know that cookies are needed from my browser with --cookies-from-browser (browser) "link", but was given "Unable to extract video URL". Have updated to latest version (2026/08/19). I also notice this only happens with premium videos, whereas normal ones download as intended. Please help.

### Region

_No response_

### Example URLs

<https://soundcloud.com/miles-dll/late-night-disco>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

It would be useful for me to have the original filename of Soundcloud downloads which have downloads enabled, since the name of the file often differs from the `artist - title` displayed on Soundcloud. I'm not sure if there's an existing infodict field which would be appropriate to use, though.

This can be retrieved using a `HEAD` request to the url for the `download` format, which has the original filename in its `content-disposition`. This seems to already be done to get the file extension for the `download` format via the `urlhandle_detect_ext` function ([soundcloud.py#L289](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/yt_dlp/extractor/soundcloud.py#L289)), but it doesn't store the actual filename.

This may also be useful for any other sites which have similar downloading functionality which retains original filenames (Odysee i believe has this?)

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Region

Australia

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

ABC iView, Australia playlist URLs are normally recognised by yt-dlp as such and all episodes in a show are downloaded. I noticed yesterday that there is now an error: "Unable to extract initial state".

I have encountered the error with a variety of shows uploaded recently and others uploaded 2 years ago suggesting iView have changed the backend of all pages. Have also tested individual seasons as well as groups of seasons.

I have attached verbose logs of the error and of a successful download from 2025.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I need to get `engagementPanels` to get artist, track, album etc. info which `%(track)s`, `%(artist)s` templates don't return unfortunately to add it to downloaded video name. `player_responses` contains it in saint of saints `_real_extract()` method of YouTube extractor but final dictionary don't contains it, so it would be nice to get an optional `player_responses` `YoutubeDL` class parameter to append this in current `extract_info()` dictionary (and probably `--player-responses` CLI argument). I know that `engagementPanels` parsed to get comments and likes info but not video music info so I can get it manually.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

[](https://github.com/m1karii)

[m1karii](https://github.com/m1karii)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I use yt-dlp with following parameters on youtube videos almost daily:
    
    
    yt-dlp --prefer-free-formats --embed-thumbnail --embed-chapters --sponsorblock-mark "all" -S "res:1080" 
    

I have been using it this way for years and since the very beginning on every single download the following warning ocurred:
    
    
    WARNING: webm doesn't support embedding a thumbnail, mkv will be used
    

recently I had the honor of getting _an actual warning_ which i should have read. unfortunatelly since they happened to be evenly spaced from each other i think it might have been 2 or 3 days till i finally noticed it. this lead me to the realisation that i have been desensitised to WARNINGs in the context of yt-dlp as well as it lead me to think about why this warning exists in the first place? like I m nowhere telling it to `--use-webm-or-else` and according to wikipedia mkv is both "open format" and "free format" so it cannot even be argued that `--prefer-free-formats` is implying it. Can this arbitrary warning be removed? or is this a bug that appears incorrectly in certain configurations like mine?

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)on Aug 20, 2026

Workaround: If you're passing logged-in cookies to yt-dlp, try without cookies. If you're getting the error without cookies, then you'll need use a [PO token provider](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide) and the `mweb` client or (if logged-in) `web_creator` client.

This is a side effect of [#17389](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17389). The fix for that issue will also fix this one.

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Worldwide

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Behavior expected: Download a single video corresponding with the link. (In this case, live_5 aka FUJINOKAWA  
Actual behavior: Download a playlist of videos regardless of the page within the tournament directory (not including invalid links). This will always be the recap days. Notably it pulls a recap posted elsewhere, but not on this particular page.  
It appears that instead of pulling from the source provided (<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/tv/sumo/tournament/202609/><video_identifier>, it is pulling from <https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/shows/sumo/>

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/zozo1237)

[zozo1237](https://github.com/zozo1237)

opened [on Sep 19, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17701#issue-5507882736)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Today I realized that deno was out of date.  
Though I try to keep an eye on release notes I missed the [notice provided](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/tag/2026.06.09). That really bites - I've archived thousands of videos since then that might be (are likely?) of lesser quality. Since a JS runtime is so important these days and this type of issue seems like it could've affected others I figured I'd raise an issue here.

[A warning if a JS runtime is out of date](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16969) or misconfigured would certainly help. Honestly though, if there is no valid JS runtime I'd rather yt-dlp just refuse to download anything from YouTube wholesale.

I propose a command line flag that prevents yt-dlp extractors that support JS runtimes from running if there is no valid JS runtime. Something like `--ensure-js-runtimes`

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# Add expiration date from 3Cat media metadata #17737

New issue

Copy link

New issue

Copy link

Open

Open

[Add expiration date from 3Cat media metadata](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17737#top)#17737

Copy link

Labels

[site-enhancementFeature request for some website](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22site-enhancement%22)Feature request for some website[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

## Description

[](https://github.com/JoseAngelB)

[JoseAngelB](https://github.com/JoseAngelB)

opened [on Sep 25, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17737#issue-5585626180)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm requesting a site-specific feature
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Spain

### Example URLs

<https://www.3cat.cat/3cat/trailer-de-capita-tsubasa-campions/video/6425143/>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Would it be possible to add the expiration date to the metadata?

The extractor already retrieves the metadata from the web. The same way it has the date it is put online, it has the date when it will be removed at the same place, inside "informacio".  
It has:
    
    
            data_utc = try_get(informacio, lambda x: x['data_emissio']['utc'])
            timestamp = unified_timestamp(data_utc)
    

And the expiration date should be:
    
    
            expiration_utc = try_get(informacio, lambda x: x['data_caducitat']['utc'])
            expires = unified_timestamp(expiration_utc)
    

There are videos without that field, their own ones. The ones they have limited rights have it, also they are the ones geo-restricted. I can't find any video with that field and isn't geo-restricted.

I am not sure whether this should be exposed as a 3Cat-specific field or whether yt-dlp already has, or should introduce, a standard field for media expiration dates.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output
    
    
    Not needed

  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

us

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

TikTok has recently re-enabled a "Short dramas" entry point in the sidebar. Before this entry point was introduced, short drama videos were accessible via the regular video URL format:

Old format (works with yt-dlp): <https://www.tiktok.com/@muffindrama_us/video/7675708755559959821>

New format (not supported): <https://www.tiktok.com/shortdrama/episode/7675706520839033876/8>

When using the new /shortdrama/episode/... format, yt-dlp falls back to the generic extractor and then fails with:

text  
ERROR: Unsupported URL: <https://www.tiktok.com/shortdrama/episode/7675706520839033876/8>  
Note: This short drama entry point has appeared and disappeared before. It seems TikTok may be doing A/B testing or gradually rolling out this feature. The new URL structure appears to be a separate content system from the regular @username/video/ format.

Command used:

bash  
yt-dlp --cookies cookie.txt --impersonate chrome -o "output.mp4" <https://www.tiktok.com/shortdrama/episode/7675706520839033876/8>

I have updated yt-dlp to the latest nightly (nightly@2026.09.16 or newer) and the issue still persists.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Every video I try to download from Eporner fails at the same step. The extractor gets as far as loading the webpage and pulling the hash out of it but then fails.

As an example this one:

[Eporner] Extracting URL: <https://www.eporner.com/hd-porn/IdFXcRMkvDU/Pregnant-Big-Tits-and-Oil-JOI/>  
[Eporner] Pregnant-Big-Tits-and-Oil-JOI: Downloading webpage  
[Eporner] Pregnant-Big-Tits-and-Oil-JOI: Downloading video JSON  
ERROR: [Eporner] IdFXcRMkvDU: Eporner said: Authorization failed. Try to reload page.

I've tried with and without cookies. Without cookies I get has failure and with cookies I get the authorisation failed.  
I've tried refreshing the cookies.  
I've tried with and without chrome browser impersonation.  
I've tried HTTP and HTTPS. If I use HTTP it just redirects to HTTPS anyway.  
I've upgraded yt-dlp to nightly 2026.09.16.232951  
and I've double checked that I can load the actual site directly via my browser which works fine.

It does sit behind age verification but my account is age verified and I can use yt-dlp fine with other sites that sit behind age verification.

  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead

[](https://github.com/scratchmex)

[scratchmex](https://github.com/scratchmex)

opened [on Sep 24, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17722#issue-5561439301)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site

DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

when downloading with `-o -` the frags have the temp name as `--Frag{idx}`, which if multiple processes are running in the same cwd, they will collide

[yt-dlp/yt_dlp/downloader/common.py](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/c7fb478d21e9e59524befbe23f7801bb267fb880/yt_dlp/downloader/common.py#L217-L222)

Lines 217 to 222 in [c7fb478](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/c7fb478d21e9e59524befbe23f7801bb267fb880)

|  def temp_name(self, filename):   
---|---  
|  """Returns a temporary filename for the given filename."""  
|  if self.params.get('nopart', False) or filename == '-' or \   
|  (os.path.exists(filename) and not os.path.isfile(filename)):   
|  return filename  
|  return filename + '.part'  
  
[yt-dlp/yt_dlp/downloader/external.py](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/c7fb478d21e9e59524befbe23f7801bb267fb880/yt_dlp/downloader/external.py#L174)

Line 174 in [c7fb478](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/c7fb478d21e9e59524befbe23f7801bb267fb880)

|  fragment_filename = f'{tmpfilename}-Frag{frag_index}'  
---|---  
  
I propose to add the PID as a prefix to avoid this when file is stdout, if agreed by the project, I would like to make the contribution

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output
    
    
    NA

More items

This repository contains a sample plugin package for [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme).

See [yt-dlp plugins](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#plugins) for more details.

## Installation

Requires yt-dlp `2023.01.02` or above.

You can install this package with pip:
    
    
    python3 -m pip install -U https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins/archive/master.zip
    

See [installing yt-dlp plugins](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installing-plugins) for the other methods this plugin package can be installed.

## Development

See the [Plugin Development](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Plugin-Development) section of the yt-dlp wiki.

Automate your workflow from idea to production

GitHub Actions makes it easy to automate all your software workflows, now with world-class CI/CD. Build, test, and deploy your code right from GitHub.

[Learn more about getting started with Actions.](https://docs.github.com/articles/getting-started-with-github-actions)

* * *

#### Linux, macOS, Windows, ARM, and containers

Hosted runners for every major OS make it easy to build and test all your projects. Run directly on a VM or inside a container. Use your own VMs, in the cloud or on-prem, with self-hosted runners.

#### Matrix builds

Save time with matrix workflows that simultaneously test across multiple operating systems and versions of your runtime.

#### Any language

GitHub Actions supports Node.js, Python, Java, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, .NET, and more. Build, test, and deploy applications in your language of choice.

#### Live logs

See your workflow run in realtime with color and emoji. It’s one click to copy a link that highlights a specific line number to share a CI/CD failure.

#### Built-in secret store

Automate your software development practices with workflow files embracing the Git flow by codifying it in your repository.

#### Multi-container testing

Test your web service and its DB in your workflow by simply adding some `docker-compose` to your workflow file.

# Could you expand the documentation? #7

New issue

Copy link

New issue

Copy link

Open

Open

[Could you expand the documentation?](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins/issues/7#top)#7

Copy link

## Description

[](https://github.com/fcolecumberri)

[fcolecumberri](https://github.com/fcolecumberri)

opened [on Nov 2, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins/issues/7#issue-3579706314)

Issue body actions

First of all, thanks for all the effort you have put in this tool, it is awesome.  
I am trying to develop an extractor for a page but I am getting kinda lost here.  
I understand the part that I need to create a class tat inherits from `InfoExtractor` in one of the plugins directories, overload the `_real_extract(self, url)` function.  
I know that I need to find a way to get the info from the page to extract the video URL (which is not the page URL) and to do so I may use the tools that you have develop. However once I arrive to this point I am getting lost.

I don't know if that documentation exists somewhere and I just have not been able to find it and this is the first wall I have hit (in some cases like `_download_json` it gets auto-generated by `__create_download_methods` so it is not even clear what the parameters of the function are). It would be easier to contribute those tools would have some sort of documentation.

Once said that, I know that each webpage is different and that is why the need of different Extractors. However, I assume that there might be a small-ish set of common ideas behind the majority of architectures so it would be nice to have a brief documentation about what to check and where to check it as currently I am a little bit lost checking multiple requests in the `Network Monitor` trying to understand how the front-end and back-end are communicating, but I have not develop web that much and I am sure someone with more experience would have found everything way faster. Because of this, I think creating a playbook would be really useful for people that might cooperate in the future.

Reactions are currently unavailable

## Description

[](https://github.com/coletdjnz)

[coletdjnz](https://github.com/coletdjnz)

opened [on Aug 9, 2024](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins/issues/2#issue-2458729333)

Issue body actions

Consider adding a simple release GH action that packages up the plugin into a compatible zip that can be dropped in one of the valid plugin directories. This may help users that are not installing with pip.

Reactions are currently unavailable

Copy raw file

Download raw file

Outline

Edit and raw actions

This repository contains a sample plugin package for [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme).

See [yt-dlp plugins](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#plugins) for more details.

## Installation

Requires yt-dlp `2023.01.02` or above.

You can install this package with pip:
    
    
    python3 -m pip install -U https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins/archive/master.zip
    

See [installing yt-dlp plugins](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installing-plugins) for the other methods this plugin package can be installed.

## Development

See the [Plugin Development](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Plugin-Development) section of the yt-dlp wiki.
